solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Dog the German for soup

parts.note: a chow is a Chinese breed of dog
der is the masculine form of 'the' in German

explanation.surface: Someone is told to follow the German for a word meaning soup.
explanation.definitionFit: Chowder is a thick soup, typically made with seafood such as clams.

clue.text: Top bloke wanting husband

indicators.note: wanting means lacking, so the letter for husband is removed from the word for bloke

parts.note: a chap is a bloke, an ordinary man

explanation.surface: The best man is a fellow who has no spouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A cap is a top or lid, as on a bottle or pen.

clue.text: Theatrical great, one in Lionel Bart musical

indicators.note: in places the letter for one inside the title of the musical

parts.note: Oliver! is Lionel Bart's musical based on Oliver Twist
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A great of the stage takes a role in a famous West End musical.
explanation.definitionFit: Laurence Olivier was one of the most celebrated English stage actors of the twentieth century.

clue.text: Corresponding over confining wild Australian

indicators.note: confining says the two words hold the answer within their letters, spanning the gap

explanation.surface: Matching letters across the sea about keeping some Australian wildlife penned in.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits at the end of 'Corresponding' and the start of 'over'.
explanation.definitionFit: The dingo is Australia's wild dog.

clue.text: Grave missing edges, old and badly damaged

indicators.note: missing edges means the first and last letters of the word grave are dropped

parts.note: aged means old

explanation.surface: A tomb without its borders, ancient and in ruins.
explanation.definitionFit: Ravaged describes something devastated or severely harmed, as by war or disease.

clue.text: Online provocateur ignoring Republican's charge

indicators.note: ignoring means leaving out, so the letter for Republican goes from the word for online provocateur

parts.note: a troll posts inflammatory messages online to provoke others
R is the abbreviation for Republican, the US party

explanation.surface: An internet troublemaker disregards a Republican politician's accusation.
explanation.definitionFit: A toll is a fee or charge, such as one paid to use a road or bridge.

clue.text: Silver not returned for Pacific nation

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the combined letters are read in reverse

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Silverware that was never sent back from an island country.
explanation.walkthrough: AG and NOT together make AGNOT; 'returned' turns that whole run backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Tonga is an island kingdom in the South Pacific Ocean.

clue.text: Desperate lad with stitch has dropped diamonds

indicators.note: has dropped means the diamonds letter has fallen to a lower place in the run

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
D is the abbreviation for diamonds, the card suit

explanation.surface: A boy with a sewing injury has lost his jewels in a frantic moment.
explanation.walkthrough: LAD and STITCH run together as LADSTITCH; 'has dropped' moves the D down three places to give LASTDITCH.
explanation.definitionFit: A last-ditch effort is a desperate final attempt made when all else has failed.

clue.text: Work transformed into choice

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work in music

indicators.note: transformed means changed in form, so the letters of the little word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A piece of work turns into a matter of preference.
explanation.definitionFit: An option is a choice among alternatives.

clue.text: Melt away, as vehicle is hot

parts.note: a van is a road vehicle
taken as written
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on a tap

explanation.surface: Something disappears because the car has overheated.
explanation.definitionFit: To vanish is to disappear, as a crowd might melt away.

clue.text: Screw new ring roads up

indicators.note: new signals that the letters are made into something fresh, a rearrangement

explanation.surface: Traffic planners are told to reorganise the town's bypasses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Screw' looks like a verb, but it is slang for a jailer.
explanation.definitionFit: Screw is British slang for a prison officer or warder.

clue.text: Standard quantity is of greatest importance

parts.note: par is the standard or normal level, as in 'on a par'
an amount is a quantity

explanation.surface: A normal measure is said to be vital.
explanation.definitionFit: Paramount means supreme or more important than anything else.

clue.text: Doctor meeting Conservative over decay

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the word for Conservative is reversed

parts.note: a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A medic meets a right-wing politician to discuss rotting.
explanation.definitionFit: Dry rot is a fungal decay that destroys timber.

clue.text: Victory of President Bush ultimately probed by India

indicators.note: probed by means entered by, so the letter for India goes inside

parts.note: Donald Trump is a US President
India is I in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: ultimately means at the end, so take the final letter of the word Bush

explanation.surface: A win for a Republican president is investigated by an Asian country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bush' looks like the president too, but only its last letter is used.
explanation.definitionFit: A triumph is a great victory or success.

clue.text: Discuss alien sleeping the wrong way round

indicators.note: the wrong way round means the combined letters are read backwards

parts.note: ET is the film alien, the extraterrestrial
abed means in bed, sleeping

explanation.surface: An extraterrestrial lying in bed gets up at the wrong end to argue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the wrong way round' turns the joined run backwards, giving DEBATE; 'sleeping' as ABED is a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: To debate is to discuss an issue by arguing both sides.

clue.text: Sex is in the mind in much of the UK

indicators.note: is in places the word for sex within the word for the mind

parts.note: the brain is the seat of the mind
it is an old euphemism for sex or sex appeal

explanation.surface: A claim that desire is all in the head.
explanation.definitionFit: Great Britain is England, Scotland and Wales, the larger part of the United Kingdom.

clue.text: Ageism might upset venerable actor

indicators.note: upset means knocked over or disturbed, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Prejudice against older people could offend a revered performer.
explanation.definitionFit: Dame Maggie Smith was a celebrated British actress whose career spanned seven decades.

clue.text: Naive politician

definitions.meaning: a member of an environmentalist party

explanation.definitionFit: Green means inexperienced or new to something, and is also the name for a Green Party member.

clue.text: Middle Easterner's second car

parts.note: Audi is a German make of car

explanation.surface: A man from the Gulf owns a second vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A Saudi is a person from Saudi Arabia in the Middle East.

clue.text: Mother accepting employment in V&A, perhaps

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so the word for mother holds the word for employment

parts.note: mum is an informal word for mother
use means employment, as in 'put to use'

explanation.surface: A mother takes a job at a famous London institution.
explanation.definitionFit: The Victoria and Albert Museum in London is an example of a museum, signalled by 'perhaps'.

clue.text: Somewhat smug and aloof in landlocked country

indicators.note: Somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Somebody fairly self-satisfied and distant in an African country.
explanation.definitionFit: Uganda is an East African country with no coastline.

clue.text: Point in time after party

indicators.note: after places the letter for time behind the word for party

parts.note: a do is a party or celebration

explanation.surface: A suggestion to arrive on time after the celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: A dot is a small point or spot.

clue.text: Shock local star having Tesla impounded

indicators.note: impounded means locked up, so the Tesla letter is held inside

parts.note: the Sun is our local star
T is the symbol for the tesla, the unit of magnetic flux density

explanation.surface: A neighbourhood celebrity is stunned to have their electric car seized.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tesla' suggests the car maker, but it is the scientific unit.
explanation.definitionFit: To stun is to shock or stupefy someone.

clue.text: Protection of Barnet from Tehran, I suspect

indicators.note: suspect means dubious or not genuine, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An item from Iran's capital that the speaker distrusts.
explanation.walkthrough: Barnet is Cockney rhyming slang for hair (from Barnet Fair); it is also a London district, which the surface plays on.
explanation.definitionFit: A hairnet holds and protects the hair, here called by its Cockney slang name.
